fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-10-16 states that messages threatening harm were sent to the complainant following a disagreement over a personal disagreement, on 2025-10-15 around 21:35 hrs. Sanjay Raj submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000083. A witness, Madhan Palanisamy, reachable on 9000000295, was mentioned in the complaint. A further person, Siva Muthu, an intermediary, using the number 9000000256, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Jagan Raman, associated with the number 9000000369, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Messages reportedly sent from an unfamiliar number.
fields.Keywords: threat, text messages, associate, phone records, night, suspect, mobile number, apartment complex
